capabilities.name: Project creation, open, and local binding
Scene manuscript editor with autosave
Read-only manuscript and chapter reading in Plan order
capabilities.scope_note: Chapter reading retains unassigned scenes, bounds long-chapter rendering, waits for pending saves, and opens fresh scene state for editing. Reading and export share Plan ordering. Reading position is retained per book/Storyline using a scene anchor; later navigation wins over delayed first-scene loading. Browser/real-Python evidence is not packaged or full-novel usability certification.

capabilities.name: Portable project brief and act, chapter, scene, beat planning
capabilities.scope_note: The active Plan workspace stores synopsis, genre, themes, style guide, outline, acts, chapters, scene placement, beats, story-time positions, labels, and a Character Arc overview in versioned project files. Unfinished form text is retained locally per book/Storyline, and guarded brief/metadata saves refuse stale values. Dragging previews structural impact. The manuscript sidebar follows Plan order with collapsible chapters, counts, current-scene highlighting and title/chapter/POV filtering; unassigned scenes remain reachable.

capabilities.name: Evidence-backed Change Set generation, hunk review, apply, Revision, restore, and undo
capabilities.scope_note: The verified loop creates concrete Change Sets, supports include/exclude, direct edit, regeneration, and author-comment revision per deterministic hunk, enforces protected text, previews Story Memory impact, creates coordinated multi-scene AI groups, applies those groups atomically, records content-addressed Revisions, compares history, selectively restores, and undoes. Packaged GUI automation remains open.

capabilities.name: Contextual project chat with citations and durable artifact promotion
capabilities.scope_note: Assistant conversations expose Book, Scene, Chapter, Character, and Storyline scopes. Browser/real-Python journeys verify scoped discussion, regeneration, note promotion, one-request Memory permission and context receipts. Shared editorial context supplies Plan order, relevant accepted canon with evidence/knowledge limits, and active Storyline intent to chat, desktop voice preparation and whole-scene generation/drafting. Memory projection does not redact previous transcripts or retract active-session data. Whole-payload budgeting, mobile editorial parity, packaged streaming and novel-scale model quality remain gates. The tester-army browser journey verifies every exposed promotion menu path with explicit Memory acceptance and Writing Voice approval, private-note exclusion, literal saved content and reload.

capabilities.name: ChatGPT subscription sign-in and Codex app-server generation
capabilities.scope_note: The active Settings surface uses Codex app-server's official account flow and an isolated Codex home. Chat, proposal, draft, hunk, and merge generation can use the subscription-backed provider with streamed events and host tools. A live subscription smoke has passed, but automated rendered sign-in and packaged clean-machine coverage remain open.

capabilities.name: Structured Story Memory entries, relationships, and review-first suggestions
capabilities.scope_note: Story Memory supports typed details, aliases, tags, categories, notes, AI visibility, book/series scope, temporal relationships, evidence-linked suggestions, correction before acceptance, and bulk accept/defer/exclude. The project-wide Connection Map visualizes accepted links across every entity type, supports manual time-scoped connections, and holds explicit prose-found relationship suggestions outside canon until the author accepts them. Rendered workflows verify correction, bulk acceptance, and the relationship review boundary.

capabilities.name: Manuscript-wide prose, planning, and Story Memory search
Reusable built-in and custom Editorial Pass library
capabilities.scope_note: Built-in and custom Passes are portable, the Change Set composer can apply them, and an author-facing builder captures goal, instruction, and readable evaluation criteria. The committed seven-genre, seven-Pass regression corpus measures 1.0 targeted issue reduction with zero protected-term or introduced-name canon errors. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: Deterministic manuscript hygiene checks
capabilities.scope_note: Deterministic manuscript hygiene findings open their affected scenes. Browser/real-Python coverage exercises the empty-summary finding; evidence-backed Story Memory diagnostics have separate Canon coverage.

capabilities.name: Temporal Canon Facts, knowledge, setups/payoffs, and evidence-backed diagnostics
capabilities.scope_note: Canon Facts, validity, manuscript evidence, knowledge state, temporal relationships, setups/payoffs, open questions, Character Arc states and conflicts, dispositions, incremental affected-scene diagnostics, Change Set impact, and a seven-scenario measured diagnostic corpus are active. Broader design-partner genre data remains a release-readiness gate.

capabilities.name: Branch creation, comparison, conflict resolution, and merge
capabilities.scope_note: The Merge tool provides branch creation and keyboard switching, compatibility checking, conflict refusal, context-reviewed reconciliation and deliberate merge. Browser/real-Python coverage verifies divergent scene edits and preservation of both reviewed sides with the local provider. Named Storyline experiments are tracked separately by storylines_product.

capabilities.name: Named Storyline experiments with briefs, comparison, and selective Change Set integration
capabilities.scope_note: Storylines support experiment briefs, lifecycle actions, branch-backed isolation, coordinated multi-scene AI Change Sets, semantic deltas, impact summaries and selective integration. The browser/real-Python alternate-ending journey verifies clean-tab switching, two changed scenes, selecting one for primary integration, preserving the unselected scene and undo. Unsaved-navigation and forced-crash guarantees remain release gates.

capabilities.name: Author-controlled project Style Profile
capabilities.scope_note: Authors explicitly select exemplar scenes; the resulting descriptive metrics guide generation without imitating an external author. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: Three-direction creative generation and outcome comparison
capabilities.scope_note: Alternatives compare editorial intent, hunk scope, word delta, voice shape, Story Memory impact, and Canon risk before the author chooses a direction. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: Intent-aware Revision retrospectives
capabilities.scope_note: Revision comparison summarizes changed scenes and word deltas, linked intent and accepted hunks, Story Memory changes, and remaining diagnostics or unresolved setups. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: Generation budget policy and usage controls
capabilities.scope_note: Browser/real-Python coverage verifies individual limit clearing, numeric validation, reset, denied generation without charge or manuscript changes, successful retry accounting and refreshed usage totals while preserving unsaved limit drafts. Core workflows also reject nonfinite, subprecision and malformed policy files without generation or manuscript changes; explicit reset repairs a malformed file. This does not certify live-provider billing.

capabilities.name: Basic generation run visibility
capabilities.scope_note: The active V2 surface is a read-only history table; comparison, rerun, pinning, export, and hardening controls are not presented as shipped. A tester-army browser journey renders actual local generation records; this evidence does not broaden the partial UI scope.

capabilities.name: Commit-aware retrieval and cited Assistant context
capabilities.scope_note: Citations are available in Assistant chat; the full generation and proposal provenance viewer is not yet restored in V2.

capabilities.name: Staged Markdown, TXT, DOCX, and Scrivener import plus Markdown and DOCX export
capabilities.scope_note: Import includes structure preview, Scrivener Draft ordering and compile exclusions. Browser/real-Python journeys now cover simple prose in all four import formats, exact Markdown roundtrip, and Word export in Plan order. Packaged dialogs and richer formatting fidelity remain open; active UI retains its partial status.

capabilities.name: Atomic scene save with crash-recovery journal
capabilities.scope_note: Unsent drafts use independent editor-owned browser slots, sequence-specific retirement and a multiple-draft chooser; legacy entries remain readable. Guarded Restore is browser-tested, but native termination, eviction and a full disk archive remain gates. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: Startup health checks and guided safe repair
capabilities.scope_note: Project load checks directories, write access, revision storage, scene integrity, Codex storage, disk space, and the Python runtime. Blocking failures expose a safe repair action; clean-machine packaged-app automation remains open. Source-level tester-army browser journeys use disposable books, real Python and the local provider; native and live-provider acceptance remain separate.

capabilities.name: On-device content-free activation and trust dashboard
capabilities.scope_note: A strict allowlist records content-free scalar events inside the local project. Rendered coverage verifies golden-loop milestones, active days, review decisions, apply/undo counts, paused recording, collection persistence and exact stored event privacy. Settings displays retention information; changing retention and deleting signals remain CLI-only. No external telemetry transport exists.

capabilities.name: Workspace audit, repair, and performance baseline
capabilities.scope_note: Available through CLI while the V2 recovery experience is designed.

capabilities.name: Checksum-pinned embedded Python core and supervised sidecar
capabilities.scope_note: A real macOS application bundle has been built and its isolated embedded core verified. Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, both-architecture CI artifacts, and packaged GUI automation must pass before release readiness.

capabilities.name: Voice commands and dictation helpers
capabilities.scope_note: Helper logic remains tested, but Voice is intentionally hidden until the golden loop is proven.

capabilities.name: Generation rerun, comparison, pinning, and export
capabilities.scope_note: Pure helpers and core commands exist, but the active V2 product does not claim this workflow.
